TAL_BEASTMASTERY_MOUNTED_MANEUVERS.why: The mount takes Dash, Disengage and Dodge and can Shove with its own Strength; combat/ext/mounts.py.

BEASTMASTERY_BASE_RIDER_PACKAGE.why: The steed is a Large token the rider starts on, sharing its space; Mount/Dismount cost half Speed; Skillful Riding protects the mount's Dexterity saves; combat/ext/mounts.py.

TAL_BEASTMASTERY_ENDURING_CONTROL.why: Enduring Control makes Beast Tamer last 8 hours. The saved control and harm-ending records use the same expiry time.

TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_MONKEY_GRIP.why: Climb Speed and Advantage on climbing/hanging/swinging checks: needs climbing and elevation, which the table does not model yet.

TAL_SPIRIT_COMPANIONS_SPIRIT_REGARD.why: Advantage on a future Charisma/Wisdom/Cultivation check to communicate with, soothe, bargain with, bind, host, exorcise or command the target: a social/roleplay check outside the fight's attack and save resolution.

tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.battle_.why: Unlocks the bonded_spirit summon source (combat/rules/summons.json, requires Covenant Spirit): the Bonded Spirit appears and fights as one of the character's summoned creatures.

tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.spirit_.why: Adds +2 x Cultivation Level Hit Points to the Bonded Spirit summon (combat/rules/summons.json improvements) -- one of five printed options, the table's fixed default since there is no compile-time interactive pick (the same treatment as Bone General's default picks).

tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.ancestr.why: Learns the emotional tone (grief, hunger, duty...) behind a Read the Spirit Nature check: extra information a GM answers, not a fight effect.

tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.minor_s.why: Printed text: 'Minor Spirit Agreements cannot use combat actions, impose conditions, or create major sphere effects' -- explicitly noncombat utility (a rumor, a warning, safe passage...).

PRESSURE_POINTS_BASE_READING_TOUCH.why: Touch the Point's 'Read the Body' option: learns one fact (Bloodied, a condition, an impairment...) that a GM answers, with no fight-state effect of its own.

TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_BORROWED_TREASURE.why: Resolves as a contested Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) vs Wisdom (Perception) check that takes a carried object from the target: the table only resolves attack rolls and saving throws (no ability-check contest or carried-object/theft tracking exists in combat/typed_executor.py's effect vocabulary).
